body:
Refresh for the re-review.

## Merge

I merged `origin/main` (`e313aa663`, the #3353 merge) into the branch. The merge was clean. It is commit `7bc64be74`.

## Blockers fixed

1. The compile break. The merged main removed `PassStart::rank`. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/bore.rs` called it, so the tree failed with E0599. The code now orders the rings from `PassStart` directly:
   - Auto and Inside keep the centre-out walk.
   - Outside reverses the order and cuts the wall ring first.
   - Auto is byte-for-byte identical. The pin `bore_auto_keeps_the_centre_out_ladder_byte_for_byte` holds.
2. The missing warning. Bore Outside cuts the wall ring at the full tool width. `bore_started` now adds `StartSide::wall_first_note()` to the path notes for Outside. It adds no note for Auto and Inside. The note does not change the moves. The decision file `docs/decisions/3360-bore-pass-start.md` records this.

The new pin test is `bore_outside_names_the_full_width_wall_cut`. It fails when the note is absent for Outside, or when Auto or Inside adds it.

## Readings (debug, no sccache)

- `camcraft-motion` `bore_pass_start`: 4 passed, 0 failed. The fourth test is the new pin.
- `camcraft-motion` lib `pass_start`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app` `offset_pass_start`: 4 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored (heavy lane).
- `camcraft-app` `bore_pass_start`: 3 passed, 0 failed.

## Not run

- Heavy lanes: not run. This PR is P2, so it gets no heavy step. The full lanes run at the cut (#3558).
- The example catalog suites: not run. No toolpath golden moved. Auto output is unchanged, and no example uses Bore Outside.
- No GUI screenshot.

The PR stays a draft. Please re-review the new head.

**Label: `conflicts`.** The head `2f9bd5b4d` has no blocker, and every test above is green. But `main` moved after that test run: `fdda55e15` (the #3387 Face pass start merge) now conflicts with this branch.

The conflict is the overlap that the PR body names. Both sides add a line at the same place:

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pass_start_row.rs:18`: this branch adds `BORE_PASS_START_HINT`, and main adds `FACE_NO_PASS_ORDER` (#3387).
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs:49`: this branch adds `the_bore_passes_tab_offers_pass_start_and_shows_the_draft`, and main adds the Face test.

The two hunks are additions at the same spot, not the same logic. Keep both sides.

Next step: merge `origin/main` into the branch (never rebase), keep both additions, run the touched tests again, push, and ask for a re-check. The review above holds for `2f9bd5b4d` with main `5346bd7ac`; the remerge needs a delta review.

I merged `origin/main` (`fdda55e15`) into the branch. The merge commit is `779bf6ada`.

Class: DELTA. A hand-resolved conflict gives a DELTA. The remerge-diff shows two additions that keep both sides:

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pass_start_row.rs`: the Bore hint and the Face no-pass-order line.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs`: the Bore test and the Face test.

The two sides added different rows. I kept both rows. No logic merged.

I then merged `origin/main` (`209f62665`) into the branch. The merge commit is `0abd7dae`. That merge was clean. Its remerge-diff is empty.

The head is `0abd7dae`.

Readings on the head:
- `camcraft-motion` `bore_pass_start`: 4 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app` `bore_pass_start`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app` `offset_pass_start`: 4 passed, 2 ignored, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -j 3 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: no warnings, no errors.

A read-only delta review of `git show --remerge-diff 779bf6ada` follows.

Merge. Class: DELTA (the branch merged main `209f62665`; `git show --remerge-diff 779bf6ada` shows only the two append-both UI unions and the remerge-diff of `0abd7daeb` is empty). Review: pullrequestreview-kwDOVVonwM8AAAABZoCcnA at `0abd7daeb`. Heavy not run - owed to the cut (#3558). Nothing is pushed after this flag.

Coordinator: the merge route is the coordinator's. Another session merged this PR at 21:42Z with no trial merge here. The PR changes the planning of the Bore toolpath (Pass starts). The check of the tip c5bb09ed1 follows (the bore, pocket and pass-start suites of `motion` and `app`, the goldens, conformance, the example catalog suites, and the ui lib).
